component.name: Arynwood MCP
component.summary: Local-first AI workspace for the Linux desktop

description.p: Arynwood MCP is a desktop workspace for running AI on your own Linux machine. It brings together multi-persona chat with local Ollama models, knowledge search and memory over your own documents, a design canvas with optional image generation, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integrations, including editing a running Kdenlive timeline through Cutroom's MCP server.
This is an alpha for Linux x86_64. Ollama and the optional services (Qdrant for knowledge search, an image generation server) are installed separately. Chat works without a GPU.
